[[Category:Recipes using ricotta]]
[[Category:Recipes for paninis]]
Tender, flavorful, chicken and creamy, smooth, [[Cookbook:Ricotta|ricotta]] cheese in a warm grilled sandwich is the perfect meat and cheese sandwich combination.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] shredded cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]]
* [[Cookbook:Ricotta|Ricotta cheese]]
* Extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
* 8 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. ½-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] slices white bread
* [[Cookbook:Hot Sauce|Hot pepper sauce]] (e.g. [[Cookbook:Tabasco Sauce|tabasco]]), to taste

== Procedure ==
#Spread slices of bread liberally with ricotta cheese. [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] chicken with hot sauce and spread on in a single layer evenly on each slice of bread. Top with another slice of bread.
#Heat a grill pan or a griddle over medium high heat. Meanwhile, brush sandwiches with extra-virgin olive oil. Place sandwiches on grill, working in batches if necessary, until browned on both sides and cheese is melted. Serve warm.
